privacyHtml:
Privacy Policy for the @spark_game_bot Telegram Bot

1. General Provisions

1.1. This Privacy Policy describes how personal data belonging to users of the @spark_game_bot Telegram bot is collected, used, stored, and protected.

1.2. By using the Bot, the user fully agrees to this Policy and to the terms governing the processing of their data. Users who disagree with these terms must stop using the Bot.

1.3. The official source of news and updates is the @spark_game_news Telegram channel.

2. Data We Collect

To provide its full functionality, the Bot automatically collects and processes the following data:

  • Basic Telegram data: the user’s unique identifier (Telegram ID), name, and public username.
  • Game statistics: game results and progress, match history, and scores earned.
  • Tournament data: payment details voluntarily supplied by the user for the purpose of receiving prizes.
  • Technical data: message metadata, including the date and time of requests and button presses.

3. Purposes of Data Collection and Use

  • Profile creation: displaying the user’s name and username in their profile.
  • Leaderboards: publicly displaying usernames and game results in ranking tables.
  • Tournaments: recording competition results and arranging prize payments.
  • Communication: sending notifications about new games, tournaments, and updates.

4. Disclosure to Third Parties

4.1. User data is not sold or disclosed to third parties for marketing purposes.

4.2. Data may be disclosed only:

  • In public leaderboards, where usernames and game scores are displayed.
  • In response to a lawful request from government or law-enforcement authorities.
  • As the minimum information required by payment providers to issue prizes.

5. Data Storage and Protection

5.1. We take the necessary technical and organisational measures to protect user data.

5.2. Database access is restricted to a limited group of developers and administrators.

5.3. Payment details are not stored permanently and are deleted after the transaction is completed.

6. User Rights

Users have the right to:

  • Request information about the data stored about them.
  • Request deletion of their data, which will also delete their profile and statistics.
  • Stop using the Bot at any time.

7. Changes to This Policy

7.1. The administration may amend this Policy without prior notice.

7.2. Announcements of material changes are published in the @spark_game_news channel.

8. Contact Information

For any questions, contact @spark_game_support.
